title: Rabbinic Criticism of Chanukah Notes
body: Rabbinic figures sharply criticize a growing trend of placing handwritten notes with personal requests inside or beneath the Chanukah menorah, calling it "nonsensical" and "invented." The practice has no source or tradition in Torah, they say.

title: Rabbi Eli Schlanger Honored
body: Rabbi Eli Schlanger, a Chabad shaliach, was among 15 killed in a Sydney attack during a Chanukah menorah lighting. An airline held a flight so a close friend could attend his funeral.
